purpose: Split-flap digits that flip when they change. The mechanism is the face, so the flip is content, not chrome.

night.recipe: The flaps read --face-plate on top and --face-spent below, which keeps the top half one ramp step lighter than the bottom in both palettes so the fold still reads. The separator is --face-bg.

options.intent: The digit colour, the only colour on the face. Left at its white default the digits follow --face-ink so they stay legible on both flap tones; set it and that colour is drawn literally in both palettes.
On for 24-hour digits; off adds an AM/PM tag and drops the leading zero.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not animate anything but the digit that changed
antiPatterns.why: the flip is the only sanctioned motion; ambient motion elsewhere makes it noise

specless: Digits on flaps, no hands or ticks; the hand vocabulary does not describe it.
